course.title: Urban Planning Principles
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value:
A Real Estate company is planning to build a two-story building on a (08)   
rectangular plot that has 100 feet of street frontage and 200 feet of depth. The   
first story measures 50 feet by 200 feet and the second story measures 50 feet   
by 200 feet. Calculate FAR of the building.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2016
